mechanism_narrative: A rise in GDP above its 50-day moving average signals increased economic activity, leading to higher demand for goods and services, which in turn drives up S&P 500 prices over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of GDP growth above its 50-day moving average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A drop in the federal funds rate below 1.5% signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing and spending, which drives up S&P 500 prices over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market, leading to increased wage pressure and higher production costs, which drives down S&P 500 prices over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts above its 200-day moving average, combined with a rise in consumer spending, signals increased economic activity, leading to higher demand for goods and services, which in turn drives up S&P 500 prices over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of increased housing starts and consumer spending (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below its 50-day moving average signals decreased supply, leading to higher prices and lower S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of decreased industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 2.5%, combined with an increase in the consumer price index, signals a shift towards restrictive monetary policy, leading to decreased borrowing and spending, which drives down S&P 500 prices over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment above its 200-day moving average signals increased economic activity, leading to higher demand for goods and services, which in turn drives up S&P 500 prices over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of increased payroll employment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in consumer spending below its 50-day moving average, combined with a decrease in housing starts, signals decreased economic activity, leading to lower demand for goods and services, which in turn drives down S&P 500 prices over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of decreased consumer spending and housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).
